export.heading: Export
export.body: Download every Tracker, Tracker Version, Entry, Preset and Tag, plus your settings, as one JSON file. This is the only backup this app has.

import.heading: Import
import.body: Replaces everything on this device with the contents of an exported file. There is no merge, and it cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Replace all local data?
confirm.body: Importing discards everything below and puts the file's contents in its place.

problems.not-json: That file is not readable JSON.
problems.not-a-bundle: That file is not a Diary Calendar export.
problems.format-version: That file was exported by a different version of this app (format {{ version }}) and cannot be imported.
